model: Maternal vasomotor reflex (Randall Ts -> resistance, venous unstressed volume) and contraction autotransfusion; appended after maternal_thorax_lu2001.json
order: Entries continue the index order of model/core.c after MT_RVR; do not reorder.

parameters.name: MV_MODE
parameters.meaning: maternal vasomotor reflex: 0 off, 1 on (needs MR_MODE > 0)

parameters.name: MV_TS0
parameters.note: recomputed by simulate.run from the resting state

parameters.name: MV_KR
parameters.meaning: tissue arterial resistance gain per unit Ts above rest
parameters.source_detail: fitted to a 40 mmHg Valsalva (Fox, measured, in Lu 2001 Table 13)
parameters.note: structure as Lu 2001 / Ursino 1998 (sympathetic -> systemic resistance)

parameters.name: MV_KV
parameters.meaning: venous unstressed volume moved to stressed volume per unit Ts above rest
parameters.source_detail: fitted to a 40 mmHg Valsalva (Fox, measured, in Lu 2001 Table 13)
parameters.note: structure as Lu 2001 / Ursino 1998 (sympathetic -> venous unstressed volume)

parameters.name: MV_RMIN
parameters.meaning: lower bound of the resistance factor
parameters.source_detail: keeps R_tis,a positive when Ts falls

parameters.name: MV_TAUR
parameters.meaning: time constant of the resistance effector

parameters.name: MV_TAUV
parameters.meaning: time constant of the venous unstressed-volume effector

parameters.name: MA_VSQ
parameters.meaning: myometrial blood squeezed into the maternal veins at MA_PREF
parameters.source_detail: fitted to the CO rise during contractions in Lee et al. 1989 (+11 %)
parameters.note: compare the commonly quoted 300-500 ml per contraction

parameters.name: MA_PREF
parameters.meaning: contraction amplitude at which MA_VSQ is squeezed
parameters.source_detail: Jongen reference contraction amplitude above rest (A 2.4)
